# Tooltip

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

overlays · tier 1 · beta · runs in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For one or two lines of plain text on hover or focus: the name of an icon-only control, or
the whole of a label that truncates. Anything with a link or a control is a Popover, and
the popup's children are typed as text, so an element is refused at compile time.

```tsx
<TooltipRoot>
  <TooltipTrigger
    render={
      <Button variant="ghost" aria-label="Copy link">
        <Svg icon={linkSimple} />
      </Button>
    }
  />
  <TooltipPopup placement="top">Copy link</TooltipPopup>
</TooltipRoot>
```

Three flat parts, `TooltipRoot`, `TooltipTrigger` and `TooltipPopup`, and no bare
`Tooltip`. Touch never shows a tooltip and Base UI links the popup to nothing, so the
trigger's own name must carry the text: give an icon-only trigger an `aria-label` equal to
it. `delay` and `closeDelay` go on the trigger and are clamped to 0 to 10000 ms; left out,
Base UI's 600 and 0 apply, or the shared delay of the app's provider. `placement` goes on
the popup; `start` and `end` mirror in Arabic.

The trigger's whole content, text or icon, goes inside the Button passed to `render`, as
in `render={<Button>Save</Button>}`, never inside `TooltipTrigger`: a Server Component
renders that Button before the trigger sees it, so text left on the trigger misses
Button's truncating label, and an icon left there is replaced by the spinner while the
Button is loading.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import {
  TooltipRoot,
  TooltipPopup,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from 'topclassui/tooltip'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

### TooltipRoot

This part takes no design props of its own.

### TooltipPopup

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | no | `TooltipText \| readonly TooltipText[]` | - | Text only, never an element: a link or a control belongs in a Popover (R-10.5-2). |
| `placement` | no | `top` \| `top-start` \| `top-end` \| `bottom` \| `bottom-start` \| `bottom-end` \| `start` \| `start-top` \| `start-bottom` \| `end` \| `end-top` \| `end-bottom` | `"top"` | TooltipPopup: the side and alignment it opens at; start and end mirror in Arabic. |

### TooltipTrigger

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `closeDelay` | no | `number`, min 0, max 10000 | `0` | TooltipTrigger: milliseconds it stays open after the pointer leaves, clamped. |
| `delay` | no | `number`, min 0, max 10000 | `600` | TooltipTrigger: milliseconds of hover before it opens, clamped to the limits. |

`TooltipRoot` draws no element, so it takes no `className`, `style` or `ref`. Anything else on another part is passed to the element it draws, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
